test.message: Does the institute reimburse visa fees?
test.answer: Convenience fees of third-party booking platforms are not reimbursed. [KB-01 §3.1] Registration fees for domestic conferences may be reimbursed up to ₹30,000 per conference, on production of the receipt and proof of attendance. [KB-01 §4]
